title: sticherus dichotomus
intro: Sticherus dichotomus, commonly known as the forked schizaea, is a type of fern plant native to Australia and parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sticherus dichotomus include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential to act as an anti-viral agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
